title: Motocross mechanical realism, soil morphology and solo practice reference review

reviewMethod.root: All 100 images visually reviewed on five labeled 20-image sheets. Three reviewers then inspected their assigned ranges and selected originals.

interpretation: New means an observed principle supports a change in this pass; it does not count one new feature per image. Retained means an existing system was checked. Context is not a new content claim.
Source URLs, game/platform labels and visual-focus strings are retained from the supplied index. Screenshot capture hardware and current storefront metadata were not independently verified.

Still images support proportion, attachment, material and riding-readability observations. Contact impulses and gameplay thresholds are derived/calibrated in the simulation, not measured from photographs.
The five wandering wheel channels, helmet/goggles, plastics, knobbies, roost, spectator work and recoverable whip were implemented in prior passes; this pass retains them.
